race.description: Tom Wells Memorial Country Boosted Mdn Hcp
race.comment: NICCONI RULES (3) Nicconi gelding from Rules Don't Apply on debut for the Colvin yard. Finished a close up second in a recent Wagga trial over 1000m. Finds a winnable contest from the inside gate. DEMANDA (7) placed here two back over this trip with a game on pace third on August 4. Jumped in trip from the wide gate with a disappointing eleventh over 1400m at Narrandera. Back to his right trip and gets his chance to break the ice. PARKER'S PARADISE (5) holding her form in stronger company and gets another chance here with Cahill's claim. Assess on the solid on pace second at Grafton two starts back. Best figures measure up. STEP QUICK (12) drops in weight and trip after failing to make an impression at his last couple of starts with the 59kg. Adept in all conditions and quickly running out of chances. PRIDE OF HAZEL (11) near her top for this and gets a better set up back to the 1180m from the inside barrier.
